decisions.reason: As a close extension of the hearing-related core business, this product has no clear sign of falling below aspiration levels yet, and the firm’s R&D base and likely slack in a growing market support keeping it on the market while learning about demand.

This product is closely aligned with established capabilities and was given a dedicated launch presence, so under bounded rationality the firm would likely continue it because early evidence does not indicate a performance shortfall large enough to trigger withdrawal.

The vacuum thermoforming unit fits the firm’s existing medical-technology equipment portfolio, and in a growing industry an established German manufacturer would typically retain such a recently launched adjacent product unless results clearly missed aspirations.
